title: FDA still focused on Taylor Farms lettuce as Cyclospora source despite retracted test
script: This is a short news brief with the key details. The main headline is this: FDA still focused on Taylor Farms lettuce as Cyclospora source despite retracted test. In simple words, The FDA says lettuce distributed by Taylor Fresh Foods and Taylor Farms de Mexico is still linked to the multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis.
